title: Doc: slot_remove_keystore needs comment explaining no proto check
description: slot_add_keystore checks the proto field when scanning the slot table to distinguish flash vs fsdir backends for a given path. slot_remove_keystore does not check proto — it removes the first slot matching the path. This asymmetry is intentional (paths are unique per backend type by construction) but is not documented at the call site. A future reader or reviewer will flag it as a potential bug or make a change that breaks the invariant. Fix: add a comment at the slot_remove_keystore scan loop explaining that proto is not checked because path uniqueness per backend type is a construction-time invariant, and document what would need to change if that assumption were ever relaxed.
